newsitem.title: USA: United Park City plans $6 mln rights offer.
newsitem.headline: United Park City plans $6 mln rights offer.

text.p: United Park City Mines Co said Wednesday its board has approved a plan to raise $6 million through the issuance of common shares in a rights offering to it shareholders.
Proceeds will be used to repay debt, fund company operations and finance development of real property in the Park City, Utah, area, it said.
In the offering shareholders will receive the right to buy an additional share for every five shares held at the record date, which the company expects will be sometime in August.
Each right will also entitle h olders to subscribe to one additional common share at a price to be determined later, it said.
Sharholders who subscribe to all shares available to them will be entitled to buy unsubscribed shares, it said. The rights are not transferrable and will not tradable, it said.
